question: Who received the Nobel Prize in 1901 for ‘recognition of the extraordinary services rendered by the discovery of the laws of chemical dynamics and osmotic pressure in solutions’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jacobus Henricus van 't Hoff.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jacobus Henricus van 't Hoff:-**

 
 
• He was a Dutch chemist and the first winner of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
 
• He is considered one of the founders of stereochemistry and physical chemistry.
 
• He received the **Nobel Prize in 1901 **for his contribution to the** laws of chemical dynamics** and** osmotic pressure** in solutions.
 
• His work laid the foundation for the** study of physical chemistry** and was instrumental in the development of the **field of thermodynamics.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hermann Emil Fischer:-**

 
 
• He** **was a **German chemist** who won the **Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1902** for his work on the** structure and synthesis of organic compounds. **
 
 
 
• **Svante August Arrhenius:-**
 
 
• He was a **Swedish chemist** who won the **Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1903** for his work on** electrolytic theory. **
 
 
 
• **Henri Moissan:-**
 
 
• He​** **was a** French chemist **who won the** Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1906** for his work on the** isolation of fluorine.**
